text: I feel a kind of in-betweenness: not quite in one place, nor in another. The muffled world through my mask reminds me of distant transitions—moments in airports, moving between lives and states of being. These spaces, designed for learning and innovation, feel like thresholds. The repetition in your words echoes in my mind, pulling me forward, half here, half already gone. I feel anticipation, tinged with detachment, as if I am already departing even as I observe.
